controls.title: Unified PrincipalContext
controls.requirement: Every authenticated request SHALL resolve to a normalized PrincipalContext before authorization or capability execution.

controls.title: Authentication and authorization separation
controls.requirement: Authentication SHALL establish identity and authorization SHALL independently evaluate action, resource, tenant, environment and policy.

controls.title: API-key lifecycle
controls.requirement: Machine credentials SHALL support issuance, one-time display, expiry, rotation, revocation, compromise and disabled states with non-secret metadata.

controls.title: Non-recoverable API-key storage
controls.requirement: API-key secrets SHALL never be stored or logged in plaintext; verification material SHALL use a keyed digest with a separately managed server pepper.

controls.title: Provider-neutral OAuth and OIDC
controls.requirement: Interactive authentication SHALL use an identity-provider abstraction with Authorization Code + PKCE and issuer, audience, resource, time, signature and scope validation.

controls.title: Fail-closed capability authorization
controls.requirement: Every protected tool, resource and administrative action SHALL receive an explicit allow or deny decision; unavailable or malformed policy data SHALL deny and produce an explainable internal decision.

controls.title: Non-escalating delegation
controls.requirement: Delegated permissions SHALL be a subset of the delegating principal's effective permissions and SHALL be bound to purpose, target, expiry and provenance.

controls.title: Distinct agent and workload identities
controls.requirement: ATLANTIS, SWARM workers, HITMAN lineage and CI workloads SHALL use distinct, short-lived, least-privilege identities rather than inheriting a universal credential.

controls.title: Vault-backed secret roots
controls.requirement: Root peppers, signing keys and provider credentials SHALL be brokered from an approved vault or workload identity; plaintext secrets SHALL not enter source, prompts, logs, fixtures or browser bundles.

controls.title: Credential and policy auditability
controls.requirement: Authentication, authorization, credential lifecycle, delegation, approval, tool invocation and verification events SHALL be correlated, redacted and retained according to an explicit policy.

controls.title: MCP protected-resource authorization
controls.requirement: Remote MCP endpoints SHALL implement standards-compatible bearer-token challenges, protected-resource metadata, scope handling and authenticated tool/resource execution.

controls.title: Negative and conformance verification
controls.requirement: Each control SHALL have linked implementation, positive, negative/security, integration or conformance evidence before it can be marked verified.

controls.title: Identity trust release gate
controls.requirement: No identity or MCP production release SHALL pass while a critical control is unverified, a trace link is missing, independent review is absent or required negative evidence is stale.
